# Public UTF-8 Boolean helper fixture

The existing guarded source-function publication example generated the provider
inside a Docker worker with copied read-only sources. The public Edict build
then compiled the retained helper source against that explicit publication,
using the independently reproduced/promoted lowerer and verifier components.
Package and report bytes are retained unchanged; guest/host raw hashes agree.
`provenance.json` records the selected snapshots, publication, component hashes
and package pin. The authored lawpack is retained for reproduction.

The helper uses a typed byte parameter, UTF-8 predicate, Boolean equality,
nonempty conjunction, negation and Boolean return. Runtime tests check literal
truth values, the full declared byte bound, an over-bound input and insufficient
scan work. These are private computation witnesses, not editor mutation,
persistent rope, Tick, receipt or recovery evidence.
